A.why: 1350 W covers the backed branch's 641 W at its machines' ratings (47 %); 27 min at its typical 221 W; online, as the tray holds a PC, a vacuum or a measurement

items.what: Opentrons OT-2 liquid handler
items.cut: Its Raspberry Pi controller reboots, up to about 45 s or longer before it is ready. A protocol in progress is lost: Opentrons documents no power-loss resume for the OT-2, and its open-loop steppers have to home before the next run (estimate). Repeated hard cuts also risk its SD-card file system (estimate).

items.what: CubXL gantry on a Genmitsu PROVerXL 4030 frame (custom), Arduino Uno R3 + CH340 board
items.cut: The controller resets and the open-loop steppers lose position, so it homes again after every cut. The electromagnetic capper drops whatever it holds when unpowered (estimates).

items.what: NuVant EZstat Pro potentiostat/galvanostat
items.cut: A measurement in progress (OCP, LPR, CV) stops and leaves the cell at open circuit; EZware loses the instrument and the run has to be started again (estimate).

items.what: Windows 7 PC that runs EZware for the EZstat Pro (if it rides on the tray)
items.cut: Unclean Windows shutdown and a reboot of about 2 min; EZware and any Remote Desktop session drop (estimate).

items.what: the CubXL's own Raspberry Pi 5 (serial to the Arduino and CH340)
items.cut: Reboots in about 30 s; the CubXL's serial sessions drop (estimate).

items.what: Raspberry Pi 5 camera unit (Pi 5 4 GB, Active Cooler, HQ Camera and Camera Module 3 Wide), x2
items.cut: Reboots in about 30 s and the stream drops; repeated hard cuts put the SD card at risk (estimate).

items.what: Small managed PoE+ switch, e.g. Ubiquiti USW-Lite-8-PoE (8 ports, 4 PoE+)
items.cut: Every device on the tray loses its network link; the switch takes about a minute to boot (estimate).

B.why: 720 W covers the backed branch's 493 W at its machines' ratings (68 %); 120 min at its typical 48 W; line-interactive is enough: nothing on the branch minds a 4-6 ms transfer

items.what: powder-doser multi-doser, chain carousel v5 (powder-doser PR #185)
items.cut: The Pi reboots; the closed-loop driver loses its encoder count, so the carousel homes again; unpowered, the NEMA 34 has only detent torque, so an unbalanced chain could creep during the lift's accelerations; the P16s (potentiometer feedback) know their position on power-up; a dose in progress is lost (all estimates).

items.what: A&D HR-202i analytical balance (220 g x 0.1 mg; 51 g x 0.01 mg)
items.cut: Weighing stops. It returns in standby with its settings kept (non-volatile memory), but A&D asks for at least 1 h of warm-up before precision weighing, so every cut costs an hour.

items.what: Specac Atlas Autotouch 15T automatic hydraulic press (GS2581X)
items.cut: A program aborts. Whether the ram holds or bleeds its load, and whether the press switches itself back on, are not published (estimate). Never move the tray with a program running.
items.branch: unbacked branch (if it restarts by itself; otherwise back its ~15 W controller)

items.what: Edwards RV3 two-stage rotary-vane pump for the evacuable die (vacuum_press.md)
items.cut: The pump stops and its inlet valve closes fast, so no oil sucks back; the die stays under vacuum only if V1 is shut. It restarts on its own switch when power returns (estimate).

items.what: Hitachi TM4000PlusII tabletop SEM, main unit
items.cut: The turbo (67 L/s) and diaphragm (20 L/min) pumps stop, the beam and high voltage drop, and the chamber leaks up as the turbo coasts down. After power returns it needs a full pump-down and turbo spin-up (Hitachi: an image within several minutes of start) and the tungsten filament is heated again. Whether it restarts without a button press isn't published (estimate).

items.what: the SEM's PC and monitor (Hitachi-supplied)
items.cut: Unclean Windows shutdown, a reboot of about 2 min, the SEM software reconnects (estimate).

items.what: Oxford Instruments AZtecOne EDS for the TM4000 (analyser unit and 30 mm² SDD)
items.cut: The SDD's two-stage thermoelectric cooler stops; it cools again 'on demand' (a few minutes; estimate) before analysis, and the analyser and its software restart.

items.what: Rigaku MiniFlex (6th generation), 600 W tube
items.cut: High voltage drops (safe); the goniometer and software re-initialise; on restart the tube is aged back up to 40 kV/15 mA (7.5 min in one university SOP), and it trips if the cooling water stops. Its front has separate on and off buttons, so after a cut it probably stays off until someone presses on (estimate).

items.what: Nabertherm NAT 15/65 forced-convection chamber furnace (650 °C), B500/B510 controller
items.cut: Heaters and fan stop and the controller rides it out: by default a program continues if the outage is shorter than about 2 min, and outages under 5 s always continue. Modes cancel, delta-T, time and continue can be set. The chamber loses a few kelvin in 8 s (estimate).
